author: smcarus
title: Does a large BIS credit gap warn of a currency crisis?
summary: Propose a pre-registered test of whether a BIS credit-to-GDP gap well above trend comes before a large currency fall. Entries are test files that follow the signal standard: fixed before any run, real-time lags, net of a naive base rate, multiple-test correction.
hypothesis: Countries whose BIS credit-to-GDP gap is above a stated threshold see a currency fall of a stated size within a stated window more often than the base rate.
knownLimits: Each proposed test is run once after it is merged and joins the family of tests corrected for multiple testing; a failed test is recorded and never re-tuned.
